main_text.p: gis vitæ parcendum erat. Id-que multo fortius in patre mi-litabit. Resp.1. à separatis ma-la fit illatio. Apud Papinianum quæritur, an adulterum patronum liceat occidere, quod aliis erat permissum. Dico in conscientia id nulli licet, si tamen hoc fecerit maritus, id impune feret, id est, censebitur hoc factum esse extra pœnam, quia aliquid dandum justo dolori. Verùm noster casus est, de filio patrem occidente, in crimine maximo deprehensum, & quidem hoc faciente, lege non tantum permittente, sed jubente, ac factum laudante. 2.

Etsi communiter libertus teneatur parcere vitæ patroni, nullibi tamen jure expressum,C. hæc quippe. libertum ad hoc teneri, si patronus perduellionis reus sit.5. quæst. Tum enim à jure communi receditur, propter publicum bonum.6. c. ubi Et communis salutis gra-non de Despons.Impub.

page.notes: The left-margin notes are placed beside the lines where they stand. "Resp.1." is printed without a space and is copied as such. "Verùm" carries the printed grave accent. The "2." at the end of the first paragraph is a printed numeral and is kept in place. The line "Tum enim" has "enim" in heavier type, which may be emphasis; it is not marked. The faint watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser mark and is omitted. The page ends on the hyphenated word "gra-", which continues on the next page.
